query_text: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name

SELECT DISTINCT sd.service_id
FROM service_dependencies sd
JOIN resources r ON sd.resource_id = r.id
WHERE r.id = 'resource:redis-west'
ORDER BY sd.service_id

SELECT DISTINCT sc.capability_id
FROM service_dependencies sd
JOIN resources r ON sd.resource_id = r.id
JOIN service_capabilities sc ON sc.service_id = sd.service_id
WHERE r.id = 'resource:redis-west'
ORDER BY sc.capability_id

SELECT DISTINCT so.team_id
FROM service_dependencies sd
JOIN resources r ON sd.resource_id = r.id
JOIN service_ownerships so ON so.service_id = sd.service_id
WHERE r.id = 'resource:redis-west'
ORDER BY so.team_id

SELECT DISTINCT itc.test_id
FROM service_dependencies sd
JOIN resources r ON sd.resource_id = r.id
JOIN integration_test_coverage itc ON itc.service_id = sd.service_id
WHERE r.id = 'resource:redis-west'
ORDER BY itc.test_id

SELECT DISTINCT sc.capability_id
FROM service_dependencies sd
JOIN resources r ON sd.resource_id = r.id
JOIN service_capabilities sc ON sc.service_id = sd.service_id
LEFT JOIN runbook_capability_coverage rcc ON rcc.capability_id = sc.capability_id
WHERE r.id = 'resource:redis-west'
  AND rcc.capability_id IS NULL
ORDER BY sc.capability_id

SELECT DISTINCT e.id
FROM service_dependencies sd
JOIN resources r ON sd.resource_id = r.id
JOIN service_capabilities sc ON sc.service_id = sd.service_id
LEFT JOIN runbook_capability_coverage rcc ON rcc.capability_id = sc.capability_id
JOIN service_deployments sdep ON sdep.service_id = sd.service_id
JOIN environments e ON e.id = sdep.environment_id
WHERE r.id = 'resource:redis-west'
  AND rcc.capability_id IS NULL
  AND e.name LIKE '%production%'
ORDER BY e.id

SELECT DISTINCT e.id, e.name
FROM service_dependencies sd
JOIN resources r ON sd.resource_id = r.id
JOIN service_capabilities sc ON sc.service_id = sd.service_id
LEFT JOIN runbook_capability_coverage rcc ON rcc.capability_id = sc.capability_id
JOIN service_deployments sdep ON sdep.service_id = sd.service_id
JOIN environments e ON e.id = sdep.environment_id
WHERE r.id = 'resource:redis-west'
  AND rcc.capability_id IS NULL
ORDER BY e.id

SELECT so.service_id, so.team_id, t.name
FROM service_dependencies sd
JOIN service_ownerships so ON so.service_id = sd.service_id
JOIN teams t ON t.id = so.team_id
WHERE sd.resource_id = 'resource:redis-west'
